_about: The turkeys, the goats, the billy goat and the foxes: their size, speed and strength, how they hunt, flee, swim and drown, what a blow does to them, and how the animals from the animal pack move, fall and are dragged.

MAX_ENEMIES.about: room for this many animals at once, a count: turkeys, goats, the billy goat and foxes together

AWAKE.about: animals further than this from Prosio rest

BUMP_GAIN.about: A bump hits with Prosio's momentum: his weight times his speed. An enemy digs in and soaks up the first part of that (its grip); only what is left over throws it: launch speed = BUMP_GAIN * (weight * speed - grip) / enemy's weight So a lean Prosio just bounces off, and the throw grows quickly with weight.

BONK.about: How hard an enemy shoves Prosio: speed = BONK * enemy's weight / Prosio's weight

ENEMY_KG.about: A big farm turkey, a goat, and the billy goat, who weighs more than an ordinary Prosio.

ENEMY_RADIUS.about: how big each kind is: its radius on the ground in metres, which also sets how big it is drawn; raise it and it is bigger and bumps into things sooner

ENEMY_SPEED.about: (faster than a turkey: a goat is a runner)

GOAT_CHARGE.about: how many times its own speed a goat charges at

ENEMY_GRIP.about: its grip in the bump above: how much of his momentum (kg times m/s) it soaks up before it moves at all; raise it and a bump throws it less

MEAT_KG.about: Knocked out, a turkey or a goat is dead: its body lies where it fell for BODY_LIFE, and chopped up at the fire it gives this many kilograms of meat, in pieces of ITEM_KG[.Meat] (food.json): a turkey 16 pieces, about 4,800 kcal; a goat 53, about 15,900; the billy goat 84, about 25,300. (A real carcass gives about twice as much; this is less, for balance.) A fox only slinks off for a while. Raise one and that kind gives more meat

KILLED_BACK.about: seconds, at random in this range, before another takes the place of an animal that was killed (chopped up, rotted away or drowned): about a season, seven days of play, so the meadow can be hunted out and a pen is the sure way to have meat; raise it and the flocks take longer to come back

RESPAWN.about: seconds, at random in this range, before another of each kind takes the place of one that is gone but was not killed: lost in the fog, or a fox that slunk off (as it was, times MEADOW_SLOW: a turkey 75 to 120 minutes, a fox 15 to 30)

BODY_LIFE.about: seconds a dead body lies where it fell before it is gone; the longer it has lain, the poorer its meat

LEASH.about: An animal that has chased him this far from its home gives up, and ambles back for GIVE_UP seconds whatever he does.

GIVE_UP.about: seconds it ambles back home once it has gone past its LEASH, whatever he does

EGG_EVERY.about: a turkey lays an egg every so many seconds, at random in this range: only now and then (as it was, times MEADOW_SLOW)

SHAKE_EGG.about: chance that shaking a held turkey shakes an egg out of it: hardly ever

PEN_EGG_EVERY.about: a penned turkey, settled and fed, lays far more often: two to four eggs a day

MILK_EVERY.about: seconds until a milked goat has milk again: 45 minutes, so a jug or two a day

SOUR_SIGHT.about: A goat he has hit will not lick him, however salty he is, until it has not seen him (he is further off than SOUR_SIGHT) for SOUR_FORGET seconds.

SOUR_FORGET.about: seconds a goat he hit must go without seeing him before it will lick him again; raise it and it bears a grudge longer

FOX_NOTICE.about: how far off a fox scents his sack

FOX_REST.about: seconds a fox keeps away after a theft or a fright

FOX_PATIENCE.about: seconds it carries what it took before eating it wherever it is

SWIM_SPEED.about: Thrown into the pond, an animal swims for the nearest bank, this fast (m/s) and losing this much health a second while it does: a fox swims well, a goat tires, and a turkey is no swimmer at all, so one that lands far out goes bottoms up (comically: feet in the air, cross eyes, bubbles), then sinks out of sight: nothing of it comes ashore.

DROWN_RATE.about: health each kind loses every second it swims (out of ENEMY_HEALTH); at 0 it never drowns

SWIM_SINK.about: how far down it sits in the water

SINK_WAIT.about: seconds a drowned one floats bottoms up,

SINK_DEPTH.about: until it is this deep, and gone

ENEMY_HEALTH.about: Every animal has the same measure of health, ENEMY_HEALTH, and every kind of blow takes from it: being thrown, bumped, bashed on the ground, hit by a rock or by another animal, stomped on. What a blow takes goes with the square of its speed, measured against how sturdy that kind is: a blow at its sturdy speed takes HARD_BLOW. A heavy animal is the less sturdy, since it comes down that much harder: a toss a turkey shrugs off would break a billy goat. With no health left it is knocked out for good. Left alone for HEAL_AFTER seconds it starts to mend, HEAL_RATE a second.

HARD_BLOW.about: health a blow at the kind's sturdy speed takes; it goes with the square of the speed, so a blow half as fast takes a quarter of this

ENEMY_STURDY.about: each kind's sturdy speed, in m/s: a blow this fast takes HARD_BLOW; raise it and that kind is harder to hurt

HEAL_RATE.about: health it mends each second once it has been left alone long enough

HEAL_AFTER.about: seconds since it was last hurt before it starts to mend

HURT_SLOW.about: how fast it still goes with almost no health left, as a share

STOMP_K.about: Prosio comes down on an animal: the blow is his weight times the height he came down from (the top of his jump), times STOMP_K. Every Prosio hits as hard, since a heavy one cannot jump as high: weight times jump height is always 36 (more with a rock in his arms). It takes from the animal's health like any blow: all of it at ENEMY_TOUGH, so a turkey is done for by two stomps, a goat by four and the billy goat by five.

ENEMY_TOUGH.about: the stomp (his weight times the height he came down from, kg times metres) that takes all of a kind's health; raise it and it takes more stomps

boldness_and_alarm._about: When one of a flock takes a real blow, the others nearby may run for it: each with a chance that goes with how dangerous he is (threat times SCATTER), so from a strong Prosio nearly all of them scatter and from a weak one hardly any. The one that was hit may run too, once it is up.

FEARLESS_BELOW.about: A small, weak Prosio they know they can beat, and they press him harder: faster, from further off, more of them at once. This is 1 when he is no danger to them at all (threat under FEARLESS_BELOW) and 0 once he is (RESPECT_ABOVE and over), which the pig he starts as already is.

RESPECT_ABOVE.about: the threat (0 to 1) from which they no longer press him; their boldness fades out between FEARLESS_BELOW and this

BOLD_SPEED.about: how much faster the boldest are

BOLD_NOTICE.about: and from how much further off they come for him

WARY_FROM.about: A big, strong Prosio they fear: from threat WARY_FROM they dart in less, and hardly at all from WARY_FULL.

WARY_FULL.about: the threat (0 to 1) from which they hardly dart in at all; their wariness grows between WARY_FROM and this

ALARM_BLOW.about: a blow at least this hard is noticed

ALARM_RANGE.about: metres: animals of the same flock within this of the one hit may run

SCATTER.about: each one's chance of running is his threat times this (never above 0.95); raise it and more of them scatter

pack_animals_moving._about: The goats and the fox drawn from the animal pack: when they walk and gallop, how they turn, and their heads. How it goes from standing to walking to galloping, by its speed (m/s): each blends into the next, on one stride cycle, so nothing jumps. A goat on four legs cannot slide sideways (see quad_steer):

QUAD_EYE_SIZE.about: small closed or crossed eye marks in this rig's units

QUAD_VIEW_ROOM.about: an animal out of the picture is not bent or drawn: how much further than at rest any of it may reach in a pose (lying down, held, kicking), as a share of its reach at rest

QUAD_GRAB_KICK.about: how far a held animal's free legs kick out as it struggles, as a share of its radius

QUAD_GRAB_TWIST.about: how far (radians) a held animal's front half twists and rolls as it struggles

QUAD_GALLOP_FROM.about: the gallop starts to take over (only a charge is this fast: chasing, backing off or trotting up it walks, briskly),

QUAD_GALLOP_SLOWEST.about: a gallop's legs never go slower than this share of their own pace

QUAD_SHORT_STEP.about: going slowly it takes shorter steps: this share of the walk's own, quicker for it,

QUAD_LONG_STEP_AT.about: growing to the full step at this speed (m/s)

QUAD_HEAD_TURN.about: how far (radians) a packed animal turns its head to watch him,

QUAD_HEAD_SPEED.about: how fast it turns it (radians a second; with him behind it, it looks ahead)

QUAD_GOAT_ACCEL.about: how fast it gets up to speed, or stops (m/s each second; the drawn ones 10),

QUAD_TURN.about: how fast it turns (radians a second),

QUAD_BACKWARDS.about: how fast it backs off, facing him (m/s),

QUAD_SLOWEST.about: it walks no slower than this (m/s): it stands, or walks;

QUAD_SET_OFF.about: standing, it sets off once it wants to go this fast, and walking it stops below

QUAD_STOP.about: this (so it does not creep, its legs barely moving),

QUAD_TURN_STEP.about: turning on the spot, its hooves step as if it walked this far (m) for each radian

pack_animals_body._about: How their bodies follow a turn, give way when pushed, and struggle when held.

QUAD_BODY_FOLLOW.about: Feed the authored gaits from actual travel and turns after collisions.

QUAD_REAR_TWIST_MAX.about: the most (radians) its hips swing round behind its chest in a turn or a sideways shove

QUAD_BODY_LEAN_MAX.about: the most (radians) its body leans in a turn or a sideways shove

QUAD_YIELD_TIME.about: seconds a goat or a fox gives way, stepping aside, when he pushes into it (a fox also backs off this long after eating what it stole)

QUAD_YIELD_SPEED.about: how fast it steps aside when it gives way, m/s

QUAD_YIELD_MIN_SPEED.about: it gives way when he presses into it faster than this, m/s,

QUAD_YIELD_OVERLAP.about: or when he is this far into it, in metres

dragging._about: A body dragged along the ground.

QUAD_DRAG_SETTLE.about: Pitch and roll of the fallen clip, measured so the head, ribs and forelegs share the ground instead of balancing on a low ear.

QUAD_DRAG_HIP_PITCH.about: how far (radians) a dragged body's hips are tipped, against its front half

QUAD_DRAG_HIP_ROLL.about: how far (radians) its hips roll over,

QUAD_DRAG_HIP_PULL.about: and how much further (radians) they roll as he pulls it sideways

QUAD_DRAG_HIGH_TAIL.about: grip height in fox radii before the hips lift more

QUAD_DRAG_TAIL_LIFT.about: the most (radians) a dragged fox's hips tip further up when he holds it higher than QUAD_DRAG_HIGH_TAIL

QUAD_DRAG_REACH_MARGIN.about: the share of a held leg's full length it may stretch to reach his hoof: just under 1, so it never locks straight

impacts._about: What a blow does to an animal: by the speed it is knocked at, it is pushed, stumbles, falls or is launched, then tumbles, settles and gets up.

IMPACT_STUMBLE_SPEED.about: Speed transferred to the animal, after its grip and mass have absorbed the blow.

IMPACT_FALL_SPEED.about: from this speed (m/s) a blow knocks it over; below it, it only stumbles

IMPACT_LAUNCH_SPEED.about: from this speed (m/s) a blow sends it flying

IMPACT_MIN_PUSH.about: even the lightest blow moves it at least this fast, m/s

IMPACT_MAX_RISE.about: the fastest (m/s) a blow sends it upwards

IMPACT_RISE_SHARE.about: the share of a launch's speed that goes upwards

IMPACT_SPIN_PER_SPEED.about: how fast it spins when knocked over or flying, radians a second for each m/s of the blow,

IMPACT_MAX_SPIN.about: but never faster than this, radians a second

IMPACT_REBOUND_SPEED.about: coming down faster than this (m/s), it bounces

IMPACT_RESTITUTION.about: the share of its falling speed a bounce sends back up

IMPACT_LANDING_KEEP.about: the share of its speed along the ground it keeps each time it comes down

IMPACT_TUMBLE_TIME.about: seconds it tumbles once it has landed

IMPACT_FALL_TIP_TIME.about: seconds it takes to tip over when knocked down without flying

IMPACT_SETTLE_TIME.about: seconds it takes to settle on its side

IMPACT_DOWN_TIME.about: seconds it lies there before it gets up

IMPACT_GET_UP_TIME.about: seconds it takes to get back on its feet

IMPACT_TUMBLE_DRAG.about: how fast it slows while it tumbles and lies there, m/s each second,

IMPACT_SLIDE_DRAG.about: and this much more for each m/s it is still going

IMPACT_BRACE_DRAG.about: how fast it slows when only pushed or stumbling, m/s each second

IMPACT_SPIN_DRAG.about: how fast its tumbling spin dies away, radians a second each second

IMPACT_BRACE_TIME.about: seconds it staggers when pushed, or when it stumbles

IMPACT_BRACE_LEAN.about: how far (radians) it leans with the blow as it staggers

IMPACT_BEND_TIME.about: seconds its legs take to fold up as it flies or tumbles

IMPACT_SIDE_ANGLE.about: how far (radians) it lies over once down: a little short of flat on its side

IMPACT_GROUND_BLEND_HEIGHT.about: below this height (metres) a flying body is eased onto the ground, so it does not sink in

IMPACT_SIDE_BIAS.about: how much a fall tips it onto its side rather than over its head or tail

impact_pose._about: How a knocked animal's body and legs are drawn while it stumbles and falls.

IMPACT_QUAD_PIVOT.about: the height, in its radii, a goat or a fox turns about as it falls

IMPACT_STEP_ANGLE.about: how far (radians) its legs swing as it staggers

IMPACT_HIND_TUCK.about: how far (radians) its hind legs fold once it is down

IMPACT_LEG_SPLAY.about: how far (radians) its legs splay out sideways once it is down
